m.t: Siempre pasamos nuestras vacaciones junto al mar.
m.e: We always spend our vacation by the sea.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2191991 by Shishir; English translation #247892 by CK

m.t: ¿Por qué "embaixo" se escribe junto y "em cima" separado?
m.e: Why is "embaixo" written together and "em cima" written separately?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2926395 by hayastan; English translation #10140994 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Podría ser una buena idea trabajar juntas esta noche.
m.e: It might be a good idea if we work together tonight.

m.t: Necesitan estar a salvo, juntas, bajo el mismo techo.
m.e: They need to be safe with each other under the same roof.

m.t: Todo lo que hemos hecho juntas sucedió, lo quieras creer o no.
m.e: Everything that we did together happened, whether you want to believe it or not.

m.t: Y no tengo dudas de que juntas podremos hacerlo.
m.e: And I have no doubt that together we will be able to do it.

m.t: Dos palabras que no se oyen muy a menudo juntas.
m.e: Two words you don't hear together often enough.

m.t: La población de Japón es mayor que la de Inglaterra y Francia juntas.
m.e: Japan's population is larger than that of Britain and France put together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #931672 by azulmarino; English translation #281425 by CN

m.t: Incluso cuando no sabía dónde estaba, me hacía sentir que estábamos juntas aún.
m.e: Even though I didn't know where she was, it-it made me feel like we were still together.

m.t: ¿Te acuerdas cuando cogimos el tren juntas, solo nosotras dos?
m.e: Remember when we took the train together, Just the two of us?

m.t: Ayer me encontré con una amiga y fuimos a tomar un aperitivo juntas.
m.e: I met up with a friend yesterday and we went out for some drinks together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1264422 by nancy; English translation #10563378 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Veamos que más hay allí afuera juntas.
m.e: Let's see what else is out there together.

m.t: ¿Deberíamos comer juntas uno de estos días?
m.e: Should we eat together one of these days?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8787046 by carlosalberto; English translation #8787029 by carlosalberto

m.t: Todas las partes tienen que trabajar juntas.
m.e: All the parts need to work together.

m.t: Estamos tratando de poner algunas piezas juntas.
m.e: We're trying to put some pieces together.

m.t: Pasemos todo el fin de semana juntas.
m.e: Let's spend all weekend together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3028975 by marcelostockle; English translation #2821268 by CK

m.t: Teoría y práctica no van necesariamente juntas.
m.e: Theory and practice do not necessarily go together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1336338 by hayastan; English translation #325355 by U2FS

m.t: Pasamos un fin de semana juntas.
m.e: Yeah. We spent a weekend together.

m.t: Las flautas tienen que tocar juntas.
m.e: The flutes need to play together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8699390 by Eremon; English translation #5978120 by mailohilohi

m.t: No podríamos estar menos juntas.
m.e: We couldn't be any less together.

m.t: Tengo todas las cosas juntas.
m.e: I got all the stuff together.

m.t: - Maze, siento que, últimamente, ya sabes, hemos estado juntas mucho tiempo.
m.e: - Maze, I feel like, you know, we've been hanging out a lot lately.

m.t: Trabajamos juntas como un equipo.
m.e: We work together as a team.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10365083 by Seael; English translation #9059711 by CK

m.t: Las flautas no están tocando juntas.
m.e: The flutes aren't playing together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8699389 by Eremon; English translation #5978097 by mailohilohi

m.t: Las aves suelen volar juntas.
m.e: Birds often fly together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1386351 by marcelostockle; English translation #680985 by Source_VOA

m.t: No quieren que trabajemos juntas.
m.e: They don't want us working together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2964488 by marcelostockle; English translation #2033679 by CK

m.t: Creí que estábamos juntas.
m.e: I thought we were together.

m.t: Estamos en esto juntas.
m.e: We are in this together.

m.t: Pasemos esta noche juntas.
m.e: Let us spend this night together.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10808846 by carlosalberto; English translation #10808829 by carlosalberto

m.t: Trabajamos juntas. Así nos conocimos.
m.e: We work together, that's how we met.

m.t: No, no si "suficientemente bueno" significaba que tenía que ser como él.
m.e: No, not if being "good enough" meant I had to be like him.

m.t: No sé si eso significaba tomarme uno o dos días.
m.e: I didn't know if that meant take a day, two days.

m.t: Sí, parece que la noche contigo Significaba absolutamente nada para él.
m.e: Yeah, it looks like that night with you meant absolutely nothing to him.

m.t: Pero no sabía que eso significaba un loco monstruo gigante.
m.e: But I didn't know that meant giant, crazy monster.

m.t: Hace 30 años, perdí cada maldita cosa que significaba algo para mí.
m.e: Thirty years ago, I lost every goddamn thing that meant anything to me.

m.t: Él sabía lo que significaba y yo no puedo recordar las palabras.
m.e: He knew what it meant and I can't remember the words.

m.t: Sabía lo mucho que el collar significaba para ella, así que lo compré.
m.e: I knew how much that necklace meant to her, so I bought it.

m.t: Porque significaba mucho para ti y tu familia.
m.e: Because it meant a lot to you and your family.

m.t: Verás, porque pensé que significaba algo para ti.
m.e: You see, because I thought that she meant something to you.

m.t: Sé lo mucho que significaba ella para ti.
m.e: I know how much she meant to you.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4600193 by DarkHollow; English translation #4597492 by Hybrid

m.t: Habría pensado que significaba para ti más que eso.
m.e: Would have thought he meant more to you than that.

m.t: ¿Por qué significaba tanto para tu padre?
m.e: Why did it mean so much to your father?

m.t: "Segundo, esas otras cosas no significan una mierda."
m.e: "Second, what others think doesn't mean shit."

m.t: Pero los números en la parte inferior, no significan nada.
m.e: But the numbers on the bottom, they don't mean anything.

m.t: Si buscas las letras, realmente no significan mucho.
m.e: If you look at the lyrics, they don't really mean much.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2595 by sarostegui; English translation #1389 by Zifre

m.t: Así que por lo que puedo decirte, no significan nada.
m.e: So as far as I can tell, they don't mean anything.

m.t: ¿Qué significan las palabras en la bandera árabe?
m.e: What do those words in the Arabian flag mean?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1056305 by alexmarcelo; English translation #1359340 by marcelostockle

m.t: Sabemos que utiliza chicas que no significan nada para usted para su beneficio financiero.
m.e: We know that you use girls who mean nothing to you for financial gain.

m.t: Son las pequeñas cosas en la vida las que más significan.
m.e: It's the little things in life that mean the most.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3978761 by NooryLan; English translation #3978370 by patgfisher

m.t: Sabes cuándo significan para mí el muchacho y tú.
m.e: You know how much you and the boy mean to me.

m.t: Las vidas de esos hombres significan tanto para mí como para ti.
m.e: Those men's lives mean as much to me as they do to you.

m.t: Tus estúpidos juguetes mortales no significan nada para mí.
m.e: Your stupid mortal toys mean nothing to me.

m.t: Los títulos y honores no significan nada para mí.
m.e: Titles and honors mean nothing to me.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4774135 by DarkHollow; English translation #4773223 by Muelisto

m.t: ¿Ya no significan nada para ti?
m.e: Do they mean anything to you anymore?

m.t: Parte de mí siente que no va a significar diferencia alguna.
m.e: Part of me feels like it's not gonna make a difference.

m.t: Lo que podría significar que se disparó a sí mismo.
m.e: Which could mean he shot himself.

m.t: Dices eso como si tuviera que significar algo para mí, pero... no.
m.e: Uh-huh. You say that like it's supposed to mean something to me, but...naw.

m.t: No conozco ninguna palabra aquí que pudiera significar "poli".
m.e: I don't know that I know any word here that could mean the word "cop."

m.t: Es decir... ese mensaje puede significar cualquier cosa.
m.e: I mean... that... that message can mean anything.

m.t: De otro modo, podría significar que has estado viendo un fantasma.
m.e: Otherwise, it could mean you've been seeing a ghost.

m.t: Diez segundos pueden significar la vida o la muerte.
m.e: Ten seconds can mean life or death.

m.t: Puede significar la diferencia entre la guerra y la paz.
m.e: It may mean the difference between war and peace.

m.t: Y siento decir que eso puede significar perder algo de tiempo familiar.
m.e: And I'm sorry to say that may mean missing out on some family time.

m.t: Ese nombre debería significar algo para ti.
m.e: That name should mean something to you.

m.t: Y eso tiene que significar algo.
m.e: And that's gotta mean something.

m.t: De hecho, es tu oportunidad para asegurarte de que tu carrera vuelve a significar algo.
m.e: In fact, it's your chance to make sure that your career means something again.

m.t: Entonces eso significaría que mi hijo está realmente roto.
m.e: Then that would mean that my son is really, truly broken.

m.t: Eso significaría que tuve a un hijo como a los 12 años.
m.e: - That would mean that i had a kid at like 12.

m.t: Porque si fuera yo, significaría que fuiste tú.
m.e: Because if it was me, then that means it was you.

m.t: Tendré algo para usted en las próximas 24 horas... eso significaría trabajar juntos.
m.e: I will have something for you in the next 24 hours that would mean us working together.

m.t: ¿Alguien ha pensado en lo que eso significaría?
m.e: Has anyone thought about what that will mean?

m.t: Y eso significaría que tienes que comprar ropa nueva.
m.e: And that would mean you have to buy all new clothes.

m.t: Sabes lo que significaría un descubrimiento para este país, para mi pueblo.
m.e: You know what a discovery would mean to this country, to my people.

m.t: Si gano, eso significaría el fin de tu gente.
m.e: If I win, that would mean the end of your people.

m.t: Significaría mucho para ella y para mí, claro, que tú fueras.
m.e: It would mean a lot to her and to me, of course, if you would come.

m.t: Renunciar significaría perder todo lo que se ha conseguido hasta ahora.
m.e: Quitting means giving up everything you've earned up to now.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1281842 by Shishir; English translation #10056571 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: ¿Alguna vez pensaste lo que eso significaría para ella?
m.e: Did you ever stop to think how that would feel to her?

m.t: Creo que significaría mucho para él saber cuánto te preocupa.
m.e: I think it would mean a lot to him to know how worried you are.

m.t: No creo que eso signifique exactamente lo que cree que significa.
m.e: I-I don't think that means exactly what you think it means.

m.t: Es decir, puede... puede que no signifique nada, ¿sabes?
m.e: I mean, may... maybe it doesn't mean anything, you know?

m.t: Sólo va a tratar de encontrarse a sí mismo, lo que signifique.
m.e: Just goes to try and find himself, whatever that means.

m.t: Yo ... yo no creo que eso significa lo que quiere que signifique.
m.e: I don't think that that means what you want it to mean.

m.t: O quizá solo signifique que es un niño.
m.e: Or maybe it just means he's a boy.

m.t: No creo que signifique que tenga que perder a mis hijos.
m.e: I just don't think it means that I should lose my kids.

m.t: Sí, quizá signifique mucho para él pero no significa lo mismo.
m.e: Yeah, it might mean as much to him but it does not mean the same things.

m.t: Aun si eso signifique herir a las personas que te importan.
m.e: Even if that means hurting people you care about.

m.t: Yo simplemente... no quiero que mi vida no signifique nada, ¿sabes?
m.e: I just... don't want my life to mean nothing, you know?

m.t: ¿Aunque el hacer lo correcto... signifique no tenerte de vuelta?
m.e: Even if doing the right thing... means not having you back?

m.t: Pero puedes enviar un mensaje que realmente signifique algo.
m.e: But you can send a message that actually means something.

m.t: Me importa una mierda lo que signifique "indiferencia".
m.e: I don't give a shit what "indifference" means.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1707883 by teskmon; English translation #1547310 by \N

m.t: Ustedes no pueden ser felices todo el tiempo.
m.e: You can't be happy all the time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8193936 by ljradio; English translation #1950719 by CK

m.t: Deben haber estado muy felices hace un momento.
m.e: They must've felt so happy a while ago.

m.t: Cuando mis hijos están felices, yo soy feliz.
m.e: When my children are happy, I'm happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2154856 by hayastan; English translation #2044891 by CK

m.t: Los ricos no siempre son más felices que los pobres.
m.e: The rich are not always happier than the poor.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1060943 by hayastan; English translation #18538 by Zifre

m.t: Mi etapa en el colegio será uno de mis recuerdos más felices.
m.e: My time in school will be one of my happiest memories.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1681707 by teskmon; English translation #21472 by Whiskkebarr

m.t: Querer cosas nos hace más felices que realmente tenerlas.
m.e: Wanting things makes us happier than actually having them.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3113277 by marcelostockle; English translation #2151531 by fekundulo

m.t: Comprendí lo rara que eran las personas felices.
m.e: I realized how rare happy people were.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1365973 by marcelostockle; English translation #257374 by CK

m.t: Todos estábamos muy felices en el desayuno.
m.e: We were all very happy at breakfast.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1189887 by marcelostockle; English translation #28830 by CK

m.t: Fueron muy felices y tuvieron muchos hijos.
m.e: They were happy and had many children.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4087798 by hayastan; English translation #4102951 by jmcd93

m.t: Por supuesto, muchos ciudadanos de la tercera edad son felices con el retiro.
m.e: Of course, many senior citizens are happy with retirement.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1235071 by marcelostockle; English translation #30527 by CK

m.t: Esos fueron nuestros años más felices.
m.e: Those were our happiest years.

m.t: Creo que ahora todos somos felices.
m.e: I think we're all happy now.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3328308 by Shishir; English translation #10596640 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Todos ustedes se ven tan felices.
m.e: You all look so happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4613582 by DarkHollow; English translation #2044503 by CK

m.t: Ustedes dos también deberían estar felices.
m.e: You should both be happy as well.

m.t: Los ricos no son siempre felices.
m.e: The rich are not always happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #661692 by darinmex; English translation #18514 by CK

m.t: Siempre quiso que todos fueran felices.
m.e: He always wanted everyone to be happy.

m.t: Seca tus lágrimas, vienen días felices.
m.e: Wipe away your tears, happy days are ahead.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #13378554 by Lernema; English translation #13377838 by Igider

m.t: Familias felices. ¿Tuviste un bonito viaje?
m.e: Happy families. Nice trip?

m.t: Tal vez puedan ser felices.
m.e: Maybe they can be happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1105205 by Shishir; English translation #1388185 by CK

m.t: Me encantan los finales felices.
m.e: I love happy endings.

m.t: Pienso que son felices.
m.e: I think they're happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5003734 by DerKommisar; English translation #5001791 by CK

m.t: Ahora todos están felices.
m.e: Now everyone's happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7061262 by luischir; English translation #7060161 by Hybrid

m.t: Los niños son felices.
m.e: The children are happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4570683 by Shishir; English translation #4494474 by CK

m.t: Los niños serán felices.
m.e: The children will be happy.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4408748 by Shishir; English translation #4410147 by XenoKat

m.t: ¿Las dos estáis felices?
m.e: Are you two happy?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1917744 by Shishir; English translation #1886292 by CK

m.t: Y éramos felices ahí.
m.e: And we were happy there.

m.t: - Me gusta verlos felices.
m.e: - I do like seeing them happy.

m.t: Mi mujer y yo éramos muy felices... hasta que nos conocimos.
m.e: My wife and I were once very happy... until we met each other.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5995092 by rafaeldejesus8199; English translation #9057343 by rafaeldejesus8199

m.t: Es por eso que no pude venir aquí.
m.e: That is why I could not come here.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #758535 by Shishir; English translation #43125 by \N

m.t: Tú vas a venir conmigo porque conoces la zona.
m.e: You are gonna come with me 'cause you know the area.

m.t: Voy a venir tan pronto como pueda, lo prometo.
m.e: I'll come as soon as I can, I promise.

m.t: Aún puedes venir a trabajar con nosotros.
m.e: You can still come work with us.

m.t: ¿De verdad va a venir?
m.e: Is he really coming?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2055586 by Shishir; English translation #2040303 by halfb1t

m.t: El año que viene puedes venir con nosotros.
m.e: Next year you can come with us.

m.t: Lo mejor aun estaba por venir.
m.e: The best was yet to come.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3115473 by Darukeru; English translation #2144237 by freddy1

m.t: Sabíamos que ella no podría venir.
m.e: We knew she wouldn't be able to come.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #7633084 by mervert1; English translation #7633082 by mervert1

m.t: Salgamos de aquí antes de que venga la policía.
m.e: Let's get out of here before the police come.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1136458 by alexmarcelo; English translation #1334588 by CK

m.t: Venga, levántate, vas a llegar tarde a la escuela.
m.e: Come on, get up. You're going to be late to school.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9751137 by Shishir; English translation #9778676 by helloroto

m.t: Espera aquí hasta que él venga, por favor.
m.e: Please wait here until he comes.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1810747 by marcelostockle; English translation #391968 by CK

m.t: Venga aquí hoy en la tarde entre las dos y las tres.
m.e: Come here this afternoon between two and three.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3106104 by marcelostockle; English translation #3106109 by Theocracy

m.t: Muy probablemente venga él.
m.e: It's very likely he'll come.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #4979955 by cueyayotl; English translation #2768778 by CK

m.t: Aún pienso que es poco probable que él venga hoy.
m.e: I still think it's unlikely that he'll come today.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1331228 by marcelostockle; English translation #953621 by CK

m.t: Quizá venga mañana, quizá no vino ayer solo porque mañana tendrá más tiempo.
m.e: Maybe she will come tomorrow; maybe she didn't come yesterday only because tomorrow she will have more free time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1393424 by Shishir; English translation #1393420 by Eldad

m.t: Yo le hablaré al respecto la próxima vez que él venga.
m.e: I will tell him about it when he comes next time.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1202250 by marcelostockle; English translation #58898 by CM

m.t: Mira, no he venido aquí a hablar de trabajo.
m.e: Look, I didn't come here to talk about work.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10007959 by Shishir; English translation #10009468 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Dice que iba a haber venido, pero que no pudo.
m.e: He says he would've come, but couldn't.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8322249 by arh; English translation #9725755 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: He venido para decir esto.
m.e: I came in order to say this.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11035437 by carlosalberto; English translation #8619720 by ajje

m.t: Todavía no ha venido. Puede que le haya pasado algo.
m.e: He has not come yet. Something may have happened to him.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #651701 by Shishir; English translation #283293 by CK

m.t: La gracia todavía no ha venido.
m.e: Grace has not come yet.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #618712 by Shishir; English translation #62778 by CN

m.t: ¿Y si vienen a por mis hijos después?
m.e: What if they come after my kids next?

m.t: Todas las cosas buenas vienen de tres en tres.
m.e: All good things come in threes.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #12310118 by Adelpa; English translation #2131313 by freddy1

m.t: Ellos vienen de la misma ciudad.
m.e: They come from the same town.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1699305 by marcelostockle; English translation #1699201 by Spamster

m.t: Las chicas más lindas vienen de Lituania.
m.e: The most beautiful girls are from Lithuania.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1318001 by alexmarcelo; English translation #947491 by CN

m.t: Si los estudiantes no vienen, la lección no comienza.
m.e: If students don't come, the lesson doesn't start.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #3191726 by cueyayotl; English translation #3160019 by \N

m.t: ¿A qué hora vienen hoy?
m.e: What time are they coming today?

m.t: Lentamente vienen las ideas.
m.e: The ideas come slowly.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1100927 by Shishir; English translation #4401974 by XenoKat

m.t: Vienes de un mundo que es todo agua.
m.e: You come from a world that's all water.

m.t: Tu mayor problema es que vienes de una familia loca.
m.e: Your biggest problem is you come from a crazy family.

m.t: No sé de dónde vienes, y él tampoco.
m.e: I don't know where you're from, and neither does he.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1335458 by Shishir; English translation #257031 by CM

m.t: Me da igual si vienes o no.
m.e: It makes no difference to me whether you come or not.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #857695 by ildefonk; English translation #249727 by CK

m.t: Solo quisiera saber si vienes o no.
m.e: I'd just like to know if you're coming or not.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1945396 by marcelostockle; English translation #1934836 by CK

m.t: ¿Mañana no vienes a la fiesta?
m.e: Aren't you coming to the party tomorrow?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2132187 by Shishir; English translation #961597 by CK
